test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In what ratio does a grocer mix tea at Rs. 26 per kg and Rs. 32 per kg so that by selling the mixture at Rs. 30 per kg they may gain 10% ?
solution:
Given: 

Selling price of the mixture = 30 per kg 

Profit percent = 10% 

Formula used:

Profit percent = [(SP - CP)/ CP]× 100 

⇒ 10 = [(30 - CP)/ CP] × 100 

⇒ 10 CP = 3000 - 100 CP 

⇒ 110 CP = 3000 

⇒ CP = Rs. 300/11

Let the quantity of the first variety of tea = x

Let the quantity of the second variety of tea = y 

According to the question: 

26 × x + 32 × y = (x + y) 300/11

(26x + 32y) × 11 = 300x + 300y 

52y = 14x 

x : y = 26 : 7

∴ The required ratio is 26: 7
